description:
【750W High-Power Motor for Thrilling Rides】Experience the adrenaline of a 750W peak brushless hub motor that delivers smooth, powerful performance across various terrains. It provides high torque while consuming less power for improved efficiency. Reach speeds of up to 25 MPH and tackle steep hills with confidence. Whether cruising through the city or exploring rugged trails, this e-bike makes every ride feel exciting.
【UL Certified Detachable Battery for Extended Range】Enjoy longer journeys with the 48V/15Ah detachable battery, UL certified for safety and reliability, delivering up to 35+ miles per charge—actual range varies based on rider weight, speed, and riding power. Fully recharge in just 4–6 hours with the included charger. With durable power and convenient portability, you can ride with peace of mind wherever your adventure takes you.
【Exceptional Comfort on Any Terrain】Built for both comfort and control, this electric dirt bike is equipped with 20" shock-absorbing fat tires, front and rear suspension forks, an ergonomic sport seat, and a bright LED headlight. The LCD display, front and rear disc brakes, 3-speed motor, and 7-speed transmission deliver superior handling and versatility. Designed for adult riders 5.4–6.2 ft tall, it offers long-range capability and powerful performance for commuting or off-road adventures.
【User-Friendly LCD Display & Intuitive Controls】The integrated LCD display provides real-time information including speed, battery level, error alerts, total mileage, and trip distance. Side buttons allow quick adjustments to power, standby time, backlight brightness and so on. Handlebar controls for the headlamp, turn signals, and horn make operation simple and safe, even in low-light conditions.
【Retro Design with Safety Features】Inspired by classic off-road motorcycles, this fat tire electric bike blends vintage charm with modern technology. Its aerodynamic frame minimizes drag, while the rugged metal construction supports riders up to 350 lbs. Safety features include powerful headlights, integrated turn signals, an automatic rear brake light, and responsive dual disc brakes—delivering a smooth, secure ride on every journey.
【3 Riding Modes and After-sales】Switch between 3 riding modes: Pure Electric, Pedal Assist (PAS), and Pedal-only. Whether you’re conserving energy, enjoying a leisurely ride, or taking on challenging trails, this ebikes for adults adapts to your style and terrain for a truly personalized experience.If you have any problems with the e-bike or your order, please contact us, we have professional technicians to solve the problem for you.
